name: Height
description: Height was an autonomous project-management platform for product and engineering teams. It combined tasks, projects, documents, chat, roadmaps, workflows, and AI-assisted project maintenance before the service was discontinued.
agentUseSummary: Height cannot be connected or installed because the provider shut down the service on September 24, 2025 and its application and API are no longer reachable.

providerSetup.blocker: Height announced that it would shut down on September 24, 2025. The product and API origins are no longer reachable in July 2026.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request credentials or show Connect. Keep the historical provider unavailable and reconsider only if the original provider returns with an officially supported service and API.

evidence.supports: Height's official public account announced that the service would shut down on September 24, 2025.
